escena: SCENE (stand build the night before an event, convention hall in Miami): the shot is a LONG EXPOSURE on a tripod — the crew moving through the frame dissolve into soft translucent streaks and the torch beams they carry draw continuous ribbons of light across the dark hall, while ONE element stays perfectly sharp: a tall black flight case standing still in the middle of it all, lit by a single hard work lamp. A low haze makes the torch beams read as solid trails. Nobody is recognisable and nobody looks at the camera. 24mm lens at f/8 on a tripod, several seconds of exposure. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a matte black road case in deep shadow, well outside the path of the light trails
lecho.tono: DARK near black in shadow, matte, no highlights at all
